metadata.title: Prawn Momos | Home Recipe
metadata.description:
Fresh prawns marinated in butter, soy sauce, ginger-garlic paste and coriander, rolled in momo skins and steam cooked. Well, that does sound like a beautiful love story isn't it? 
This is a simple home recipe that I came up with while experimenting with new fillings for momo. It is simple and easy to make and is delicious. 

Ingredients
Prawn     250 gms
Ginger- Garlic paste - 1 tbsp
Soy Sauce      - 1 tbsp
Butter - 2 tbsp
Coriander - 1 bunch finely chopped
Salt to taste
